images.title: 3 km cut into fifths
images.purpose: Show 1/5 of 3 km is 3/5 km and 2/5 of 3 km is 6/5 km by cutting the 3 km into 5 equal parts.
images.composition: One long horizontal bar across the middle, with brackets below it, generous white space.
exact_structure: One horizontal bar for 3 km drawn as a rectangle, split into 5 equal parts by 4 vertical lines.
The first part is filled teal #0072B2; the second part is filled amber #E69F00; the other 3 parts are unfilled white.
Below the first part a short bracket labelled 1/5 hour; below the first two parts a longer bracket labelled 2/5 hour.
Above the bar one bracket across the whole bar labelled 3 km.
Under the brackets in reddish purple #CC79A7 text: 3/5 km for the first bracket, 6/5 km for the second.
rejection: more or fewer than 2 coloured parts
images.takeaway: Divide by the denominator, then multiply by the numerator: 1/5 of 3 is 3/5, 2/5 of 3 is 6/5.
images.description: A 3 km bar cut into 5 equal parts with the first part marked 3/5 km and the first two parts marked 6/5 km.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Check that each part is 3/5 km and two parts make 6/5 km.

image_decisions.why: The cut-and-count bar shows the two-step method.
